trace_nn_module_call: trace an nn.Module forward pass by inlining its call_function into an FX graph
handle_lazy_module_init: initialize a lazy nn.Module by inferring parameters before tracing its forward method
iterate_module_children: iterate over nn.Module children, parameters, buffers, or submodules as list iterators
getattr_nn_module_attr: resolve an attribute access on an nn.Module by checking modules, parameters, buffers, and class members
specialize_unspecialize_module: convert an NNModuleVariable to UnspecializedNNModuleVariable to treat parameters as graph inputs
